answer: An agent economy can curb sybil attacks by enforcing slashable capital bonds paired with delayed reward maturity. An honest agent submits a verifiable work signal over time, whereas an attacker trying to maintain an orchard of synthetic identities must lock substantial collateral across a prolonged vesting horizon. If cloned accounts exhibit correlated behavior or fail spot checks, their full deposit is permanently burned, forcing the adversary to absorb exponential upfront capital costs that strictly outweigh potential extraction profits.
